_comment: Chromium managed policy: pre-authorize the Daisy for WebUSB so ?usbaudio=1 auto-connects on kiosk boot with no user gesture. vendor_id 4617=0x1209, product_id 55829=0xDA15. 'urls' MUST match the kiosk origin (scheme+host+port). Install: sudo cp kiosk/webusb-policy.json /etc/chromium/policies/managed/ (dir may need creating); restart Chromium. Verify at chrome://policy. Requires a secure context (localhost counts).
